notes.title: Bugs Fixed
notes.notes:
Hi guys! I am sending this message to let you know that we have adjusted several things in the game!
Thanks to all who sent messages with feedbacks! We are very grateful for all the support!

the adjusted bugs:
-inversion of controls when the gravity is changed
-person entering the wall with gravity inverter
-now you can skip the intro with space bar
-the exit portal of the tutorial now has feedback
-other internal minor errors
